Following today's "surprise event," Apple has updated its official design resources website with new bezel assets for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel assets now available

Designers should be no strangers to Apple's design resources website, which offers a variety of hardware and software assets for them to use in their own work.

These assets come in Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG file formats, covering Apple's major platforms, products, and technologies — including fonts, SF Symbols, the Icon Composer app, as well as logos and badges for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

Right after announcing the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro today, Apple promptly updated its design resources website with Photoshop and PNG assets for these two new devices.

The assets include the iPhone Duo in both folded and unfolded states, with two colour options available; as for the iPhone 18 Pro model, it features a smaller Dynamic Island.

To check out the new bezel assets and other existing resources on Apple's design resources website, click here.
